name: 80236 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80236 (Denver) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80236 (Denver) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80236 (Denver) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
